$comment: Per-config request-validation settings for camunda-oca. The Camunda 8 Orchestration Cluster API parser accepts string-enum values case-insensitively (camunda/camunda#52409), so case-only mutations would be false 400 expectations. See api-test-generator#129.

knownIssues.summary: page.limit has no enforced upper bound for plain limit-based pagination (no page.from/after/before set) — every pagination-limit-invalid aboveMaximum/wayAboveMaximum test stays red: 200 on rdbms, 500 on Elasticsearch once the value exceeds its max_result_window
